program.help:
Second-round spike detection on a spike-cleaned .dat file.
Detects spikes missed by the first pass (e.g. spikes occluded by larger neighbouring spikes) by running the standard detection pipeline on the residual recording produced by ndm_lfp with saveCleanDat=yes.
The newly detected spikes are merged into the existing .res.N/.spk.N/.clu.N files; all new spikes receive cluster ID = 0 (unclassified). Stale .fet.N files are removed.
PREREQUISITES
ndm_lfp must be run first with: subtractSpikes = yes (or auto with .spk files present) saveCleanDat = yes
The following parameters are also used (from the main session file): ndm_hipass/windowHalfLength thresholdFactor refractoryPeriod peakSearchLength start / duration (for threshold estimation window)
PARAMETERS
None — all parameters are inherited from the session parameter file.
NEXT STEPS
After ndm_redetectspikes completes: 1. Re-run ndm_pca to rebuild .fet.N feature files. 2. Re-run ndm_klustakwik or use klusters to sort the merged spike set.
